title: Jubilees 11 — Post-Babel idolatry, Mastema's bird-plague, and Abram's seed-drill

paragraphs.text: ወበ፴ ወ፭ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ሣልስ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ በቀዳማዊ፡ ዓመት፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ነሥእዎ፡ ለሬዑ፡ ብእሲተ፡ ስማ፡ ኦራ፡ ወለተ፡ ኦራ፡ ሎቱ፡ ብእሲተ፡ ወወለደት፡ ሎቱ፡ ወልደ፡ ወሰመዮ፡ ስሞ፡ ሰሩግ፡ በሰቡዕ፡ ዓመት፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡

i18n.en: And in the third week of the thirty-fifth jubilee, in the first year of it, Reu took for himself a wife whose name was Ora, the daughter of Ur, as a wife; and she bore him a son, and he called his name Serug, in the seventh year of this jubilee.

paragraphs.text: ወአኀዙ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ኖኅ፡ ይትባአሱ፡ አሐዱ፡ ለመጻዐ፡ ካልኡ፡ ወይትገበሩ፡ ቀትለ፡ ወይትፋጻኡ፡ ደመ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ ወይውግዙ፡ ምድረ፡ ወይትገበሩ፡ ሐጻነ፡ ወወለዱ፡ ኪነ፡ ለቀትል፡ ወቀምሮ፡ ለመስከባን፡

i18n.en: And the sons of Noah began to make war upon one another — to take captive and to slay one another; and to shed blood upon the earth; and to consume blood; and to build strong cities; and to make for themselves walls and towers; and one man would exalt himself above the nation; and to lay the foundations of kingdoms; and to go to war one people against another, and nation against nation, and city against city; and all to do evil; and to acquire arms; and to teach their sons war.

paragraphs.text: ወአኀዙ፡ ይትገበሩ፡ ጣዖታት፡ ወሰገዱ፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሰብእ፡ በበ፡ ሥርዐቱ፡ ዘያረኵስ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ ወአስተአተተ፡ መስተማ፡ ይግበር፡ ኪያሆሙ፡

i18n.en: And they began to make graven images; and every man worshipped them — each according to his manner that defiled the earth; and Mastema sent forth that he might do these things.

paragraphs.text: ወመስተማ፡ መልአከ፡ ጻዕር፡ አስተሐሰሰ፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ ለመዋዕል፡ ለማስኖ፡ ወለመውዓ፡ ወለክዕወ፡ ደም፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡

i18n.en: And Mastema, the angel of affliction, lent his aid to them at all times — for corruption, and for destruction, and for shedding blood upon the earth.

paragraphs.text: ወአስተአተቶሙ፡ መስተማ፡ ለመናፍስት፡ ዘይትገበሩ፡ ኵሎ፡ ግፍዐ፡ ወኵሎ፡ ኀጢአተ፡ ወኵሎ፡ ዐመፃ፡ ለሙስና፡ ወለማስኖ፡ ወለክዕወ፡ ደም፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡

i18n.en: And Mastema sent forth the spirits to do every violence and every sin and every iniquity — for corruption, and for destruction, and for shedding blood upon the earth.

paragraphs.text: በእንተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ተሰምየ፡ ስሙ፡ ለሰሩግ፡ ሰሩግ፡ እስመ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሰብእ፡ ኮኑ፡ ይትገሐሡ፡ ኀበ፡ ኵሉ፡ ኀጢአት፡

i18n.en: On account of this his name was called Serug — for every man had turned aside to every sin.

paragraphs.text: ወልሕቀ፡ ወኀደረ፡ ምድረ፡ ኦራ፡ ይእቲ፡ ምድረ፡ ካስድ፡ ቅሩበ፡ ለአቡሁ፡ ለእምሕያ፡ አቡሁ፡ ወሰገደ፡ ጣዖታተ፡ ወነሥአ፡ ሎቱ፡ ብእሲተ፡ ስማ፡ ሚልካ፡ ወለተ፡ ካበር፡ ወለተ፡ እኁሁ፡ ለአቡሁ፡

i18n.en: And he grew up, and dwelt in Ur of the Chaldees, near his father's father by his mother; and he worshipped graven images. And he took to himself a wife whose name was Milkah, the daughter of Kaber, the daughter of his father's brother.

paragraphs.text: ወወለደት፡ ሎቱ፡ ናኮር፡ በቀዳማዊ፡ ዓመት፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ሰቡዕ፡

i18n.en: And she bore him Nahor, in the first year of this week.

paragraphs.text: ወልሕቀ፡ ናኮር፡ ወመሐሮ፡ አቡሁ፡ ኪነ፡ ለመጠን፡ ኪደ፡ ከለዳዊያን፡ ለድልዋን፡ ለቀሥሞ፡ ጊዜ፡ ወከመ፡ ይትፅዐኑ፡ ቦቶሙ፡ ለኪደ፡ ሰማይ፡

i18n.en: And Nahor grew up; and his father taught him the lore of the Chaldeans — for divining and reading omens by the stars of heaven.

paragraphs.text: ወበ፴ ወ፯ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ቀዳማዊ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ በቀዳማዊ፡ ዓመት፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ ነሥአ፡ ሎቱ፡ ናኮር፡ ብእሲተ፡ ስማ፡ አያስ፡ ወለተ፡ ናስስ፡ ብእሲተ፡ ወወለደት፡ ሎቱ፡ ወልደ፡ ወሰመዮ፡ ስሞ፡ ታራ፡ በሣልስ፡ ሰቡዕ፡

i18n.en: And in the first year of the first week of the thirty-seventh jubilee Nahor took for himself a wife whose name was Iyaska, the daughter of Nestag of the Chaldeans, as a wife; and she bore him a son, and he called his name Terah, in the third week.

paragraphs.text: ወአስተአተተ፡ መስተማ፡ ቅንስናተ፡ አዕዋፍ፡ ለበሊዐ፡ ዘርእ፡ ዘይዘርእ፡ ሰብእ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ ከመ፡ ያስተአትትዎ፡ ለዘርእ፡ እምነ፡ ምድር፡ ወይትግፋዕዎሙ፡ ለደቂቀ፡ ሰብእ፡ እምነ፡ ዘርኦሙ፡

i18n.en: And Mastema sent forth ravens and birds to devour the seed which was sown upon the earth — in order to destroy the earth and to rob the sons of men of their labors.

notes.official: Mastema sends ravens against Abram's seed; Abram drives them away by speaking. The foundational text for the Abram-as-child-iconoclast tradition continued at ch 12.

paragraphs.text: ወይዘርኡ፡ ዘርአ፡ በምድር፡ ወይትራባእ፡ አዕዋፍ፡ ወይትባልዕዎ፡ እምነ፡ መንበረ፡ መንበራቲሆሙ፡ ለመረረ፡ ፍሬ፡ መጠን፡ ምድሮሙ፡ ለመውዓ፡ ለነጊር፡ ለሰብእ፡ እምነ፡ ፍሬሆሙ፡

i18n.en: Before they could plough in the seed, the ravens picked it from the surface of the ground; and on this account he called his name Terah — because the ravens and the birds reduced them to want and devoured their seed.

paragraphs.text: ወወረሐ፡ ሐራ፡ መሥራቅ፡ ወወረዱ፡ መንገለ፡ ፀሐይ፡ ወአፍርሁ፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ ለስሕተተ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ ወረከቡ፡ መከራ፡ ብዙኀ

i18n.en: And the years began to be barren, owing to the birds; and they devoured all the fruit of the trees from the trees. They could scarcely save a little of all the fruit of the earth in their days, by great labor.

paragraphs.text: ወበ፴ ወ፱ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ካልእ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ ሰዱስ፡ ዓመት፡ ነሥአ፡ ሎቱ፡ ታራ፡ ብእሲተ፡ ስማ፡ ኤድና፡ ወለተ፡ አብራም፡ ወለተ፡ እኅቱ፡ ለአቡሁ፡ ብእሲተ፡

i18n.en: And in the sixth year of the second week of the thirty-ninth jubilee Terah took for himself a wife whose name was Edna, the daughter of Abram, the daughter of his father's sister, as a wife.

paragraphs.text: ወወለደት፡ ሎቱ፡ ወልደ፡ በሳድስ፡ ዓመት፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ ወሰመዮ፡ ስሞ፡ አብራም፡ በስመ፡ አቡሁ፡ ለእሙ፡ እስመ፡ ሞተ፡ ቅድመ፡ ይትፀነሰ፡ ወልዱ፡ ለታራ፡

i18n.en: And in the seventh year of this week she bore him a son, and he called his name Abram — after the name of his mother's father; for he had died before his daughter conceived a son for Terah.

paragraphs.text: ወአኀዘ፡ ሕፃን፡ ያእምር፡ ኀጢአተ፡ ጣዖታት፡ ለመጠን፡ ኪደ፡ ኵሉ፡ ኅዙብ፡ ወይትገሐሥ፡ መንፈሰ፡ እምነ፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ ወመንፈሰ፡ ሥሣይ፡ ለረከቦ፡ ምሐራ፡ እምነ፡ አባዊሁ፡

i18n.en: And the child began to understand the errors of the earth — that all went astray after graven images and after uncleanness; and his father taught him writing, and he was two weeks of years old; and he separated himself from his father, that he might not worship graven images with him.

paragraphs.text: ወአኀዘ፡ ይጼሊ፡ ኀበ፡ ፈጣሪ፡ ኵሉ፡ ከመ፡ ያድኅኖ፡ እምነ፡ ስሕተተ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ሰብእ፡ ወከመ፡ ኢይኩን፡ መክፈልቱ፡ ለመውዓ፡ ድኅረ፡ ስሕተት፡ ለማስኖ፡

i18n.en: And he began to pray to the Creator of all things, that he might save him from the errors of the sons of men, and that his portion should not fall into error after impurity and vileness.

paragraphs.text: ወዘመነ፡ ዘርእ፡ ቦአ፡ ለዘሪዓ፡ ዘርእ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ ወወፅኡ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ኀቤሁ፡ ለመጠን፡ ይትዓቀብዎ፡ ለዘርእ፡ እምነ፡ አዕዋፍ፡ ወአብራም፡ ወልድ፡ ዘ፲ ወ፬ ዓመት፡ ወፅአ፡ ምስለ፡ እለ፡ ዘርኡ፡

i18n.en: And the seed-time came for the sowing of seed upon the earth; and they all went forth together to guard the seed from the ravens; and Abram, a child of fourteen years, went forth with those who sowed.

paragraphs.text: ወይትራባእ፡ ጊፋ፡ ዘ፷ ሕፃንየ፡ አኀዘ፡ ይኬሐል፡ ለነፋጾ፡ ቅንስናተ፡ አዕዋፍ፡ ቅድመ፡ ይውህጡ፡ ዘርአ፡

i18n.en: And a cloud of ravens came to devour the seed; and Abram ran out to meet them, before they could settle upon the ground, and he cried out to them before they settled upon the ground to devour the seed.

paragraphs.text: ወይትራባእ፡ ቅንስናተ፡ አዕዋፍ፡ መንገሌሁ፡ ወይነፍጹ፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ ሰብዐ፡ ምዕር፡ ላዕለ፡ ይእቲ፡ ዕለት፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘወድቀ፡ ቦቱ፡ ለመጠን፡ ኪያሁ፡ ዘፍሬ፡ መንበር፡

i18n.en: And he said: Descend not; return to the place from which you came — and they returned. And he caused the cloud of ravens to turn back seventy times on that day; and not one of the ravens settled upon any of the fields in which Abram was — not even one.

paragraphs.text: ወትትሥራዕ፡ ስሙ፡ ለመጠን፡ ኵሉ፡ ምድር፡ በዘ፡ መጠን፡ ጥቀ፡ ብዙኀ፡ ኮኑ፡ ኪያሁ፡ ሕያው፡ መዋዕለ፡ ሕይወቱ፡

i18n.en: And all who were with him in any of the fields saw it; and he was named famous in all the land of the Chaldees; and all who sowed seed in that year came to him — and he went with them until the seed-time was over.

paragraphs.text: ወልሕቀ፡ በውስተ፡ ይእቲ፡ ዓመት፡ ወወፅአ፡ መንገለ፡ ዘረዐ፡ ዘርእ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ ወዐቀቦ፡ ለዘርእ፡ እምነ፡ መንቅዕተ፡ አዕዋፍ፡

i18n.en: And they sowed their land, and that year brought enough food, and they ate and were satisfied.

paragraphs.text: ወገብረ፡ ኪነ፡ ለዕፀዊሆሙ፡ ቦቱ፡ ይከውን፡ ቤቶ፡ ለዘርእ፡ ይውስኩ፡ ቦቶሙ፡ ለቆስ፡ ምድረ፡ ዘይከሥቱ፡ ቆስ፡ ፍርጹጻተ፡ ለርእስ፡ ዘርእ፡ ወይውፅኡ፡ ዘርአ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘይትራባእ፡ አዕዋፍ፡ ላዕለ፡ ዘርእ፡ ሕቡእ፡ ውስተ፡ ምድር፡

i18n.en: And in the first year of the fifth week Abram taught those who made instruments for oxen — the artificers in wood — and they made an instrument above the ground, opposite the beam of the plough, in order to put the seed thereon; and the seed fell down from it upon the share of the plough, and was hidden in the earth — and they no longer feared the ravens.

paragraphs.text: ወገብሩ፡ ከመዝ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ምድር፡ ወጻድቅ፡ ኮኑ፡ በዓመቱ፡ ለመዋዕል፡ ለዘ፡ ዘርእ፡ ብዙኀ፡ በውስቴታ፡ ለበሊዕ፡ ወአልቦ፡ መከራ፡ ካልአ፡ ለመጠን፡ ዘገብረ፡ አብራም፡

i18n.en: And after this manner they made instruments above the ground on all the ploughs of all the land; and they sowed, and they tilled all the land, even as Abram commanded them — and they no longer feared the birds — through what Abram had done.
